extra.message: DOM-based Cross-Site Scripting via URL hash — An attacker can execute arbitrary JavaScript in the victim's browser, potentially stealing cookies, session tokens, or performing actions on behalf of the user. [verified: The script on line 10 uses document.write with user-controlled hash fragment (after 'lang=') without any sanitization, as confirmed by the absence of escaping or validation in the inline script. This is a classic DOM XSS that executes in the victim's browser when a crafted URL is visited.]
